LabelAllowSeekingOnMediaControlsHelp: Lets you change the playback position from the Lock Screen, Control Center and other system media controls.
MessageAutoSleepTimerWindowEmpty: The start and end times are the same, so the auto sleep timer never starts.
MessageCellularSettingsHelp: These settings also apply when Low Data Mode is on.
MessageCellularSettingsHelpMac: On a Mac, these settings apply to personal hotspots and other metered connections, and when Low Data Mode is on.
MessageLanguageSettingsHelp: Audiobookshelf uses the language you choose for it in the Settings app. That option appears once you add more than one preferred language in General > Language & Region.
MessageLanguageSettingsHelpMac: To choose the language Audiobookshelf uses, open System Settings > General > Language & Region and add it under Applications.
MessageLogsCurrentLaunchOnly: These logs cover only the current launch of the app. Tokens are always removed.
